newsitem.title: UK: Select Appointment sees Q1 EPS meeting views.
newsitem.headline: Select Appointment sees Q1 EPS meeting views.

text.p: British-based recruitment firm Select Appointments (Holdings) Plc said on Friday it expected its first-quarter revenues and earnings per share to meet analysts' forecasts.
The company said U.S. analysts expected its first-quarter revenues to reach $180 million, up 57 percent from the year-ago period, while earnings per ADS were estimated at $0.11 versus $0.07.
Each American Depositary Share represents two ordinary shares.
Select planned to release its first-quarter earnings during the week beginning May 12.
The company attributed the expected increase in sales to strong internal growth, which should approximate 30 percent, with the rest of the rise coming from recent acquisitions.
Select also said it had several acquisitions in the pipeline, most likely in Europe.
Select's shares ended unchanged at 367p in London. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
